spec.experiment: SG-combined-v1 C10 add-on: SG33 M2 coarse source
spec.reference: same-generation S0 FINE-P2, raw and R2
spec.source: SG33 M2 IPF-balanced 16x16 Markov first-arrival support; tau=0.3, cap=256, T=1, IPF tolerance=1e-5 and at most 100 iterations
spec.ca: frozen A3 class-word W, selected eleven CA modules, calls 0-30, all heads
spec.sa: matched 16/32/64 observations on calls 10-20, all eight heads, same-call hierarchy
spec.transport: C10a ordinary SG33 M2 path; C10b/c exact KL 2x2 parent conservation at both transitions; positive sum-normalized transport states
spec.completion: C10c same-call second fine pass with SG32 background rows and foreground-background odds; C10b P2 is diagnostic-only, not a selectable fourth cell
spec.selection: five frozen VOC folds; raw and R2 separately versus same-generation S0; VOC thresholds frozen for COCO; no COCO tuning
spec.diagnostics: coarse AUC uses native 16x16 sampled GT and per-call negative arrival; stage AUC uses sampled 64x64 GT for both routes; retention uses 0.45 on upsampled coarse M2 and final stage; full-resolution changes use 0.45 on normalized final maps
spec.storage: resumable confusion counts and compact per-image diagnostics; no generated images, masks, QK or dense attention matrices

raw.freeze_reason: fold vote and OOF guard passed

voc.diagnostic_note: GT enters diagnostics only; AUC is mean per image, not pooled pixel AUC; fixed 0.45 comparisons do not use cell-selected mask thresholds

coco.diagnostic_note: GT enters diagnostics only; AUC is mean per image, not pooled pixel AUC; fixed 0.45 comparisons do not use cell-selected mask thresholds
